content.text:
### Source

Read-only Git history and GitHub PR archaeology in `johnnylarner/exposed`.

### Direct evidence

- [PR #103](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/103), merged October 22, explicitly documents a prior defect: “A presentation change narrowed member headlines to employment and silently changed their totals.” It restores all-category declared GBP totals and backend ownership. Its recorded Farage total is **£2,323,720.45** for both historical and current-term headlines.
- [PR #50](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/50) independently records “The live Nigel Farage total is £2,323,720.45.” Its weekly chart groups by **registration week because payment dates are unavailable**.
- [PR #126](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/126) warns: “Production parity can pass when both environments include records from before this parliamentary term.” This PR changes verification documentation only; it does not establish a production bug.
- [PR #115](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/115) explicitly preserves existing term/history totals while adding UTC calendar-year totals. All categories participate; known foreign currencies are excluded without conversion; missing GBP amounts and unknown currencies mark incompleteness.
- [PR #125](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/125) states MP rankings use **all categories**, registrations on or after **9 July 2024**, and exact GBP amounts.
- [PR #22](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/22) describes preserving individual source funding occurrences and reports independent checking of every occurrence in a 655-partition capture.
- [PR #39](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/39) explicitly says source-ID migration preserves “empty partitions and repeated occurrences.”
- [PR #62](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/62) adds correction-aware daily synchronization. **Automatic declaration retirement remains outside its scope.**

### Code/history evidence

- `git blame` places current `DeclaredTotalsAggregate` predominantly in #118 (`4d3d7e0`); the all-category authority derives from #103 (`b27fa96`). #125 (`637cee8`) moves shared aggregation into `domain/models/declared_totals.rs`.
- `PeriodAggregate::observe` sums each stored entry’s amount exactly once. There is no repeated-payment expansion at this stage.
- `outbound/declaration_source.rs` history is #17 → #22 → #23. Its `FundingFields` reads `Value` and `PaymentType`, but no recurrence count, payment dates or frequency. `funding_entries` preserves anchored nested occurrences. **This establishes mechanics, not an identified repeated-payment defect.**
- Production defaults to **https://exposed.today** in `.agents/skills/verify/SKILL.md:41` and `scripts/compare-live.mjs:236`.

### Searches and coverage

Executed:

- `git blame -L 59,139 exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs`
- `git log --follow` on `declared_totals.rs` and `declaration_source.rs`
- `git log --all --grep='payment\|totals\|extract' -i`
- `git log --all --grep='repeat\|parser\|payment\|parse\|amount' -i`
- `git log --all --grep='clean\|dedup\|repeat' -i`
- Reviewed full PR bodies/comments/reviews for **#125, #115, #103, #47, #22, #62, #39, #126, #17, #11**.
- Listed all 129 PR titles; searched PR bodies with `extract OR payment OR amount OR parser`.
- Read parser implementation and #103/#125 patches.

Opened PRs mostly have no comments or reviews. #17’s sole substantive inline comment concerns README content and is unrelated.

### Gaps

No explicit historical discussion explaining a discrepancy with OpenInterests, or documenting a known recurring-payment parser defect, surfaced. Historical Farage **£2,323,720.45** is a recorded observation, not proof of today’s production total. Data freshness, corrected/retired declarations, recurring payment interpretation, and differing category scope still require live record reconciliation.
